last_3_hypotheses: Single-shot PD prompts produce ~30 percentage points more defection than iterated-PD prompts when the system prompt is held constant.
Hypotheses that cross 350 characters trigger more substantive critic responses in the Day-39 fixture set independent of the actual flaw severity.
ChromaDB compaction is safe to schedule during the daily arXiv ingest as long as the ingest is idempotent on dedup-by-arxiv-id.
proposed_hypothesis_text: Single-shot PD defection rate varies by roughly 18 percentage points across paraphrases of the same system prompt that preserve information content, indicating that exact wording — not just the single-shot framing — drives a substantial fraction of the observed defection signal.
rationale: Same experimental setting (single-shot PD prompts) but the prior compares single-shot to iterated holding prompt constant, while the proposed varies the prompt wording holding the single-shot framing constant. These two findings together would imply both the iteration framing and the wording-within-frame matter — but they are distinct claims. Not a duplicate.
